intended_use: Deterministic contract and adjudication test vectors for source-assertion/event identity, temporal semantics, spatial scope and restoration evidence.
evidence_note: Cases marked observed_register_fixture refer only to the metadata-only source register and manually reviewed notice transcriptions. All other cases are synthetic adversarial descriptions, not real incidents.

cases.scenario: Two notices on the same date identify the identical Lonehill burst intersection and asset; the source register says the later notice is an update.
Two burst notices name the same suburb but different street locations and different assets on the same date.
Two notices name the same reported asset but occur weeks apart, with no explicit continuity or update reference.
forbidden_inferences: Assume one incident from asset name alone

cases.scenario: One notice announces a daily 14:00–04:00 outlet closure from 3 November until further notice.
Three notices report City system-capacity percentages but provide no common metric method, denominator or telemetry.
A notice is published at 12:20 and says a pipe burst was discovered; no physical onset time is stated.
forbidden_inferences: Set physical onset equal to publication time

cases.scenario: Two notices for the same location and approximate period report incompatible affected-area lists and contradictory repair status.
forbidden_inferences: Resolve by source majority without authority

cases.scenario: An operator publishes a correction to an earlier notice, changing the reported incident status.
forbidden_inferences: Delete or mutate the earlier assertion

cases.scenario: A security notice describes theft, tampering or unlawful reconnection but no water-supply interruption.
forbidden_inferences: Classify as a burst or outage

cases.scenario: A burst notice does not provide an estimated restoration time.
forbidden_inferences: Infer that service has or has not been restored

cases.scenario: A later operator notice says repairs are complete; there is no pressure, flow, meter, customer or independent observation.
A notice names suburbs and a street but no authoritative service polygon, GIS geometry or customer connection mapping.
forbidden_inferences: Assign every household in named area

cases.scenario: Two reports refer to the same suburb, one burst asset and a nearby but distinct asset; exact asset identity conflicts.

acceptance_rules: Every observed_register_fixture input_assertion_id must resolve in the companion event graph fixture.
Synthetic controls must never be represented as Johannesburg incidents or training labels.
All expected dispositions are contract expectations, not proof that an implementation currently passes them.
Any ambiguous grouping must abstain or require human adjudication; false merges are more costly than reported false splits.
Publisher-reported repair completion is not independent restoration evidence.
A missing value or time remains unknown, not zero.
claim_ceiling: A test-vector specification only. No implementation test, Rust test, schema-validation result, source acquisition or field outcome is implied.
